claim: Markets with zero recent trading can remain permanently exempt from staleness filtering because historical volume counts as current activity.
evidence: Line 72 substitutes m.volume when volume_24h is zero, and has_volume now resets the count whenever that value exceeds 10. A market with volume=500, volume_24h=0, unchanged price and unchanged open interest therefore resets its count on every scan; seven repeated calls confirmed count=0 and no skips. filter_markets uses the same fallback, so this market also passes the default minimum-volume filter.
